strings.mdKbNet: • Network ni keybox: kebox ni keybox no (GitHub) ni thani tubuwi /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. o rwwi mano Internet nangnai tei 1-3 minit jora nangnai. Smart fetch wngwi thangphuru eba keybox no yak bai swlaijak phuru use khlaijak.

strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine naiwi naimani (porimani simi): dumpsys ni thani Widevine level ni phunukmarok (L1/L3) phunuknai, DRM (IDM) chabi-file tongmani, tei abo bai kwrwngjak system ni manwirok. Modify khaimani mungsa phano wngya.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Yago swijak RKP swnamnai: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh yago swijak. Automatic pass wngya khe sakhlainani jwngjalrokno swnamnai. Joto run wngwi kaisa klaijak line print wngwi tongo.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Puila RKP swnamdi: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh puila swnamdi. Hard case rok no handle khaio tei jora kwbang nango. Patimungni bisingtwi kaisa klaijak result nukjaknai.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: Play Store tei Google ni samungrok (GMS+GSF) ni data no swkakwi rwnai tei abo hai kheno wngwi tongnai. Kwrak khe sakhlainani bagwi simi — abo nini photo eba file rokno mungsa jorabo tangwi man ya.
strings.mdCertify: • Play rwngthoma: rwngthoma rwngthoma ni RKP rwngthoma rwngthoma ni tongmung no naiwi naiwi rwngthoma rwngthoma ni manwi rok no reset khlai nai. User ni data no ta tangdi.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER swnammani: Google samungrokni phrwngmung (SOTER) swnammani manwirokni swngmungrokno swnammani. Integrity khe thwngmani slai SOTER ni sakao depend wngnai kwbangma manwirokni bagwi use khlaijak.
strings.mdPifApply: • PIF swnamdi: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh phan bai swnamdi. Khairokjak yakni rangchak (swngcharni/swngcharni) wngwi pif.prop/pif.json filerokno kwtal khlaio. Log o kaisa klaijak result nukjaknai.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF naiwi naidi: engine ni tongmung, yakni rangchak (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop) ni rangchak no phunuknai. Check khai di — abo mungsa phano modify khlai ya.
strings.mdCanary: • Kanari kwtal: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m wngkha. Kwtal canary engine tubui phaikha, abo wngkha majra berjak RKP swijakmarok bai kwrwngwi tongna bagwi (2026 talni tal).
